title: Sparse X-ray spectro-tomography for high-sensitivity three-dimensional chemical imaging at the nanoscale
authors: Hanfei Yan

abstract: Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77821-5 The study introduces a sparse spectro‑tomography method that cuts data needs in scanning mode by about two orders of magnitude, enabling high-sensitivity, low‑dose 3D chemical imaging. It uncovers surface Co reduction and Mn loss in battery particles, revealing key degradation pathways.
